decisions.reason: The existing message-238 MODIFY already captures Datil production gating, Base ERC-721 ownership verification, Lit-node decryption, PDF encryption, and automatic reader verification.
The source does not remove or change the optional offline-download link; a download after authorized decryption remains compatible with the Lit gating approach.
The source expressly says the reader experience remains unchanged and does not alter PDF.js, read-only behavior, or the reader entry points.
The Lit storage and access-control configuration does not require any change to the currently specified FAQ content.
The source specifies ebook gating implementation but does not require Lit or Datil information to be added to the About page.
The metadata already points to an ownership-gated viewer, and the source does not change the metadata reference, schema, or visible attributes.
Ebook encryption and Lit ownership gating do not change prize-winner notification recipients, triggers, delivery, or content.
The source does not affect the Brevo transactional-email provider or its configuration.
Lit-gated ebook access does not change the deferred Transak wallet-provisioning behavior or its wallet semantics.
The source does not change the certificate email's contents, actions, or PDF.js destination; ownership gating can be integrated within the existing viewer.
The Lit storage and reader configuration does not alter the deferred Transak provider, payment methods, conversion, or mint flow.
Verifying ownership of a Base ERC-721 relies on the existing Base deployment decision but does not modify the selected blockchain network.
